high.affected_gate: UMA safety and bounded mandatory-direct staging
high.evidence: Async uploader setup failures still select a synchronous tensor-sized read_buf path; read_aligned_chunk can add another tensor-sized aligned allocation. Real tensors reach 1140850688 bytes, exceeding the 269000000-byte staging bound.
high.proposed_acceptance_test: Inject every uploader setup failure and require mandatory-direct mode to fail before tensor loading, with allocation accounting below the frozen bound.
high.reproduction_instructions: Force missing uploader capability, buffer/event allocation, or backend initialization and observe upload_backend become null and tensor-sized staging become reachable.

high.evidence: Five blocks are declared but no randomized matched runner, fixed relative scorer, complete bundle binding, external timing/read authority, or mutation-tested evidence validator exists.
high.proposed_acceptance_test: RED-test and implement the previously named five-block runner/scorer contract before a model run.
high.reproduction_instructions: Attempt to score slower-than-stock or malformed candidate rows; candidate 2 has no executable rejection path.

medium.evidence: The required option is an alias of legacy use_direct_io, so legacy --direct-io and LLAMA_ARG_DIO also become mandatory rather than opportunistic.
medium.proposed_acceptance_test: Represent optional and required modes separately and verify only the required flag fails closed.
medium.reproduction_instructions: Inject O_DIRECT open failure under each legacy and required option and compare with the pinned baseline.

medium.evidence: The recorded review source is already patched, while the patch test expects a clean source. The fault probe also depends on mutable, unrecorded shared libraries and LD_LIBRARY_PATH.
medium.proposed_acceptance_test: Bind clean exact source to patched reviewed source byte-for-byte and package/hash every loaded probe dependency and invocation environment.
medium.reproduction_instructions: Run the test against the recorded patched path, then run the probe without the unrecorded library path.

high.evidence: The eight-test GREEN fails when pointed at the recorded already-patched review source and passes only against a separate clean source or the prohibited vendor fallback.
high.proposed_acceptance_test: Materialize exact clean commit 0dc74e3, apply the patch, and compare all resulting reviewed source files byte-for-byte; prohibit vendor fallback.
high.reproduction_instructions: Set DSV4_FUSION_SOURCE_ROOT to the recorded patched tree and run the patch tests.

high.evidence: The executable matched runner/scorer and evidence validator remain intentionally absent.
high.proposed_acceptance_test: Implement the fixed five-block matched runner/scorer and malformed-evidence mutations before runtime.
high.reproduction_instructions: Attempt to execute or score the campaign using candidate-2 files.

medium.evidence: The current 4096-byte alignment fits the limit, but the limit is not calculated or enforced from runtime alignment.
medium.proposed_acceptance_test: Calculate and bind the exact four-buffer allocation and fail above the declared maximum.
medium.reproduction_instructions: Evaluate four times payload-plus-alignment-minus-one over larger supported alignments.

medium.evidence: The new required option aliases and changes the behavior of legacy opportunistic direct I/O.
medium.proposed_acceptance_test: Separate optional and required modes and preserve legacy behavior.
medium.reproduction_instructions: Fault O_DIRECT open under the legacy option and compare baseline with candidate.
